lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines identified; spacing is relatively uniform with higher frequency observed in the mid-flank section, narrowing at the anterior and posterior boundaries.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation/merging observed at the dorsal region of the 4th and 5th line segments from the anterior boundary.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 1, 3, 10, and 11 exhibit discontinuity, terminating mid-torso before reaching the ventral mass boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping of 4 distinct circular white spots located on the upper lateral hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spot blobs on the lower haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking on the snout and a prominent white patch on the ventral neck region.
